description: Lark uses access‑token based authentication for its Open Platform APIs, enabling apps to perform read and write operations on resources.

evidence.claim: Lark uses access tokens (tenant_access_token, user_access_token, app_access_token) to authenticate API calls and determine permissions
Developers can automatically obtain authentication credentials via API Explorer with one click, indicating self‑serve credential access
Access tokens allow apps to read and write data on Lark resources
